title: [2.8.2.2-dev] no refreshing of cob after entering carbs
body:
After entering 30g carbs (18:09) via carbs button on the home screen cob where not updated. Even after getting new bg reading and loop calculation cobs are not up to date. Restarting aaps at 18:16 solved this problem.
